title: Who Burned the Library?
sentences: The Library of Alexandria probably did not die in one great fire.
The popular story blames Julius Caesar, in 48 BC.
His war did start a fire, and books were lost, perhaps scrolls stored near the harbor.
But decades later, the geographer Strabo was still using its sources.
Historians describe a slow decline instead: scholars driven out, less funding, and war damage over centuries.
The library faded away, rather than burning in a single night.

caption:
